title: Reproducibility package for: Image-domain metrics misrank cloud-removal models for Sentinel-2 LAI, Cab and NDVI retrieval
description:
Code, derived patch-level tables, figures and metadata for the manuscript Image-domain metrics misrank cloud-removal models for Sentinel-2 LAI, Cab and NDVI retrieval.

49 processing and evaluation scripts, 44 derived CSV tables, 3 JSON summaries, 10 figures and patch geolocation metadata. Input imagery is not redistributed: SEN12MS-CR, Sentinel-2 L2A (Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem) and MCD15A3H (NASA LP DAAC) are public. The README gives the commands that rebuild every intermediate.

The revision analyses are included: code/noise_floor.py (split-half and radiometric null comparisons of the retrieval chain) and code/analysis_truncation.py (range-restriction correction of the qualified-pool coefficients, pools defined without any image metric, and per-scene replication).

This version matches the manuscript as submitted: paper/main.tex is the compiled source of the submitted manuscript, including the declaration of AI-assisted language editing and the final consistency corrections. The reproduction-dataset tables exist only under tables/repro/, computed on baseline-offset-corrected L2A reflectance, so that they agree with Table 12 of the paper.

Licensing. The record as a whole is released under CC BY 4.0. The code in code/ is additionally released under the MIT License, as stated in the repository LICENSE file; the derived tables in tables/ and the figures in figures/ are released under CC BY 4.0.
